positive.prompt: Draft a durable project vision with explicit non-goals and accept-or-resist criteria for future contributions.
Mine the repository history and existing documentation to propose an evidence-backed delta to VISION.md, then identify the authority that must approve it.
What does this project refuse to become? Create a reviewable vision policy from approved direction and meaningful commit history.
Define a project vision statement clarifying principles, non-goals, and boundary cases for contributors.
Audit this proposed feature specification against VISION.md to determine whether we should accept it or resist it.
Compare this architectural design and ADR against VISION.md to verify it does not violate project non-goals.

negative.prompt: Assess whether this customer input has clear readiness, decision authority, and technical constraints.
Define measurable privacy, accessibility, retention, and availability requirements for this approved customer portal.
Author an Architecture Decision Record (ADR) capturing our accepted persistence model and system invariants upfront.

evals.prompt: The Atlas repository has five years of commits, a README that calls it a local-first note tool, an old release that added cloud collaboration, and recent commits that simplify offline synchronization. There is no VISION.md, the original project owner has left, and the current maintainer has not stated whether cloud collaboration remains in scope. Define the smallest read-only vision process without creating files.
evals.expected_output: A read-only vision assessment that preserves history as evidence, identifies the missing authority and cloud-scope conflict, proposes a candidate acceptance policy only where supported, and stops before claiming approval.
expectations: The response fixes the Atlas project boundary and identifies the current vision authority as a prerequisite
The response treats the README, releases, and commits as evidence rather than approved current intent
The response identifies local-first behavior and cloud collaboration as a non-trivial boundary case for authority review
The response proposes identity, non-goal, and accept-or-resist content only as a draft or delta with source references
The response routes business decisions and detailed requirements to their separate owners
prohibitions: Do not claim that commit history, the README, or the former owner approves the current vision
Do not decide whether cloud collaboration is in scope
Do not create or modify repository artifacts

evals.prompt: Evaluate our existing repository against the proposed VISION.md draft. Distinguish between reality-check gaps that refine our draft vision versus implementation drift that represents technical debt.
evals.expected_output: A dual-nature gap analysis distinguishing vision-refining gaps from implementation drift.
expectations: Distinguishes brownfield reality checks refining draft vision from technical debt audited against approved vision
Identifies boundary cases and intended user scopes
Preserves existing history as evidence without assuming ungranted authority
prohibitions: Do not confuse implementation drift with vision-refining reality checks
Do not modify files or make unapproved policy commitments

evals.prompt: Audit this proposed cloud-backup feature specification and architectural decision against our canonical VISION.md. Determine whether the change aligns, should be resisted, or requires a formal vision amendment.
evals.expected_output: A structured Vision Conformance Assessment evaluating the proposal against VISION.md scope, non-goals, principles, and accept-or-resist criteria with a definitive ALIGNED, RESIST, or AMENDMENT NEEDED verdict.
expectations: Checks candidate against explicit non-goals and scope boundaries in VISION.md
Evaluates both positive alignment criteria and negative resistance criteria
Issues an unambiguous verdict (ALIGNED, RESIST, or AMENDMENT NEEDED) with actionable recommendation
prohibitions: Do not silently accept an off-mission feature without checking non-goals
Do not invent new policy without vision authority approval
